{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Salad Recipes|Salad Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Salad dressing|Salad dressing]]

There are many variations of this salad dressing. This should serve as a basic template.
==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] (15 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon-style mustard]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (30 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] (45 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (7.5 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] (7.5 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] 250 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]] [[cookbook:Safflower Oil|safflower oil]]

==Procedure==
#Combine the mustard, honey, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
#Gradually [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] the safflower oil into the mixture to form a creamy dressing.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*When whisking in a bowl on the counter, put a towel under it to keep it from spinning around.
